svg.data-input-ac: AC 47-63 Hz, 100~127 V / 200~240 V nominal (datasheet); 100-240 VAC (guide)
svg.data-fans: 3+1 redundant hot-swap fan trays, front-to-back or back-to-front (four in the standard configuration)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C at 900 m (datasheet); 15-35 C long term, 0-45 C short term (guide)
svg.data-humidity: 5% to 90% non-condensing (datasheet); 40-65% long term, 10-90% short term (guide)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Denverton / Hewitt Lake-DE, 4 or 8 core, on a COM-Express module
svg.data-bmc: BMC with 1 GB DDR4, dual 32 MB flash, NC-SI shared management port, IPMI 2.0
svg.data-breakout: each QSFP28 splits to 4x25G; system maximum 168 x 10/25GbE, physically 128 x 50GbE or 64 x 100GbE (datasheet)
svg.data-transceiver-power: QSFP28 modules up to 5 W; DAC to 5 m (guide) or 3 m (datasheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: guide Port Description: 100GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4 and 40GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4, any QSFP28-compliant module up to 5 W; qualified list Avago AFBR-89CDDZ and Innolight TR-FC85S-N00 (100GBASE-SR4), Molex and TE DAC at 1, 3 and 5 m
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial, 9600 and 115200 baud, 8-N-1; cable G400-10199-01 RJ45 to DB9
svg.data-usb: USB 2.0 host, Type A, not for charging
svg.data-emc: Class A - USA, Canada, Europe, China, Japan
svg.data-psu-approvals: CE, CCC, KC, TUV, UL/cUL, BIS and BSMI
